page.overview:
Who is Peter Cullen?

Peter Claver Cullen (July 28, 1941 - August 26, 2026) was a Canadian Emmy Award-Winning voice actor who voices Thaedus in Invincible.

He has earned fame, respect and admiration as the voice of Optimus Prime, leader of the Autobots in the Transformers franchise, In addition to Transformers, some of Cullen's other roles include Eeyore from Winnie the Pooh, Monterey Jack from Chip 'N Dale - Rescue Rangers, Venger from Dungeons & Dragons, K.A.R.R. from Knight Rider, the title villain from Predator, and was the announcer for a number of commercials for the U.S. Navy in 2007, filling in for [https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Keith_David Keith David].

Thaedus was his last role before his death in August 2026, aged 85. Category:Voice actors Category:A to Z Category:Deceased
